problem_text:
A hospital has 9 patients who need to complete 9 different medical tests each.

Each patient's treatment plan consists of a sequence of tests represented as pairs (Testing Lab, Duration),
where each pair specifies the lab where the test must be performed and the amount of time it requires.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the tests must be completed.

Patient treatment plans:
* Patient 1 requires the sequence: (Lab4, 9) → (Lab7, 5) → (Lab8, 8) → (Lab6, 1) → (Lab1, 10) → (Lab3, 3) → (Lab2, 3) → (Lab5, 9) → (Lab9, 10)
* Patient 2 requires the sequence: (Lab6, 1) → (Lab8, 7) → (Lab7, 1) → (Lab9, 8) → (Lab1, 2) → (Lab4, 3) → (Lab2, 5) → (Lab3, 6) → (Lab5, 5)
* Patient 3 requires the sequence: (Lab3, 5) → (Lab8, 3) → (Lab7, 10) → (Lab4, 3) → (Lab1, 2) → (Lab9, 7) → (Lab5, 9) → (Lab2, 8) → (Lab6, 9)
* Patient 4 requires the sequence: (Lab3, 2) → (Lab7, 4) → (Lab8, 2) → (Lab9, 4) → (Lab2, 8) → (Lab6, 4) → (Lab4, 1) → (Lab1, 7) → (Lab5, 6)
* Patient 5 requires the sequence: (Lab5, 4) → (Lab6, 8) → (Lab9, 1) → (Lab3, 9) → (Lab4, 10) → (Lab1, 7) → (Lab2, 6) → (Lab8, 4) → (Lab7, 10)
* Patient 6 requires the sequence: (Lab6, 7) → (Lab5, 3) → (Lab7, 5) → (Lab2, 5) → (Lab9, 10) → (Lab3, 3) → (Lab1, 7) → (Lab4, 1) → (Lab8, 2)
* Patient 7 requires the sequence: (Lab3, 6) → (Lab7, 8) → (Lab4, 9) → (Lab1, 10) → (Lab6, 2) → (Lab2, 3) → (Lab9, 3) → (Lab5, 10) → (Lab8, 10)
* Patient 8 requires the sequence: (Lab1, 1) → (Lab8, 10) → (Lab7, 4) → (Lab3, 3) → (Lab2, 8) → (Lab9, 4) → (Lab5, 9) → (Lab4, 5) → (Lab6, 10)
* Patient 9 requires the sequence: (Lab2, 10) → (Lab3, 5) → (Lab8, 1) → (Lab5, 10) → (Lab1, 7) → (Lab7, 6) → (Lab4, 2) → (Lab9, 6) → (Lab6, 5)

Each test must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each testing lab can only handle one patient's test at a time. The objective is to determine the scheduling order of all tests across the labs so that the total completion time for all patients is minimized.
